name: Upstash MCP
description: Manages Upstash Redis, Vector, Search, QStash and Workflow resources from AI agents: create databases, run Redis commands and read usage stats.

skills.name: Redis Databases
skills.description: Creates, lists, backs up and deletes Upstash Redis databases, and changes their plans, budgets and read regions.

skills.name: Run Redis Commands
skills.description: Runs Redis commands over the REST API against an Upstash database, one command at a time or as a pipeline.

skills.name: Redis Stats
skills.description: Reads Redis throughput, latency, data size, hits and misses, and per-region insights to diagnose a database.

skills.name: QStash Messages
skills.description: Publishes QStash messages, manages schedules, and reads delivery logs and the dead-letter queue.

skills.name: Vector Indexes
skills.description: Creates and inspects Upstash Vector indexes and Search databases, fetching documents and per-namespace stats.
